request: The Carbon asked for the best chat app: Silicon UI, keyboard shortcuts, voices through Deepgram's managed ElevenLabs (five most used voices, a default for every Silicon), a CLI guide on writing expressively, Accounts-style docs and AGENTS.md, agent friendly; then: deploy it all, add dm to Briefcase's upload issuers, uploads of any size (paste and drag and drop too), fix the report recipient typo.

database.note: Additive only: 0.16 ignores the new tables and columns, so rolling the code back needs no schema change (sync clients reset once).

backend.source_difference: The tag is one commit later (5988f95): the CLI's usage name only (bin_name = "dm"); service and website code are identical.
backend.upgrade: deploy/parallel/upgrade_service.py: stop 0.16, dm-migrate, runtime grants, start 0.17 (768m, 8 connections) with speech on; 19 s

speech.key: deepgram_api_key in silicon-dm/accounts-production/runtime (the Deepgram account key Waveform also uses)

briefcase.change: BRIEFCASE_PROOF_ISSUERS gains dm for briefcase.uploads.reserve|commit|status|cancel and briefcase.link_access.update; BRIEFCASE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=21600
briefcase.practical_upload_limit: about 90 GB per file today (Briefcase's staging disk), and 100 GiB a day per drive by Briefcase's default

cli.publication: Verified with the host's publish tool, rehearsed on a consistent SQLite copy, backed up before and after (silicon-apps-backup.service), published with the API stopped; before.sqlite kept in /var/lib/silicon-apps/catalog-dm-0.17.0.
cli.local_install: The Silicon Apps updater installed dm 0.17.0 on macos-aarch64 by itself; dm voices list read the five voices from production.

validation.review: Eight adversarial audit lenses (90 confirmed findings, all critical and major fixed) and an independent final check (ship).
live_after_deploy: contracts announce conversation_events, presence_activity, speech, unread
website landing, llms.txt and uploads config (enabled, uncapped)
Deepgram reachable from the host; no errors in the API, worker or website logs

limits: No signed-in production smoke was possible from the release machine: the first spoken message, Listen and voice note in production are the first real Deepgram calls through 0.17.
A real Finder folder drag was tested only with synthetic drop events (headless browsers cannot take an OS drag).
